items.title: Linux 6.6.87 LTS released with Btrfs snapshot performance fixes
items.summary: Stable release fixing snapshot latency and memory cgroup accounting.
items.content: Greg KH announced the release of Linux 6.6.87 LTS. Highlights include significant Btrfs subvolume commit speedups, zram compression improvements, and Landlock LSM seccomp integration.

items.title: THP Transparent Hugepages optimization for embedded x86_64
items.summary: New kernel config fragment reducing memory fragmentation on low-RAM systems.
items.content: Patches upstreamed to improve THP madvise mode responsiveness under memory pressure on systems with 16GB RAM or less.
